name: Shijou Ryousuke
source:
Hobby/Special Skill: Tea Ceremony, Flower Arrangement, Calligraphy, Cooking

The protagonist's classmate.
The second son of a family that owns a well established Japanese confectionery shop.
He is a courteous person who always talks politely.
He's not good at dealing with [url=/c58004]Keita[/url].
